notes: Build log starts at module transformation completion. Initial Yjs patch check and transform startup were observed in a prior tool response.
The retained Node log precedes final baseline-only codec/test refinements; no shared-reader code changed after that Node check.
The initial partial-capsule selector counterexample was observed but its red log was not retained; the regression is retained in source.
All test fixtures are synthetic. Counter MAC authentication and settled journal/owner eligibility are adapter prerequisites, not established by this pure reader.
